title: Blue Ridge Bankshares, Inc. Announces 2026 Second Quarter Results
summary: Blue Ridge Bankshares, Inc. (the "Company") (NYSE American: BRBS), the holding company of Blue Ridge Bank, National Association ("Blue Ridge Bank" or the "Bank") and BRB Financial Group, Inc., today announced financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. For the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Company reported a net loss of $0.2 million, or $0.00 per diluted common share, compared to net income of $0.8 million, or $0.01 per diluted common share, for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and net income of $1.3 million, or $0.01 per diluted common share, for the quarter ended June 30, 2025. Net loss for the second quarter of 2026 included an after-tax $2.1 million provision for credit losses, compared to an after-tax benefit for recovery of credit losses of $0.5 million for both the first quarter of 2026 and second quarter of 2025.
